dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - PostgreSQL - Query Performance
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for query monitoring, slow query IDs, execution count, elapsed time, disk reads, disk writes, statement type, and plan row estimates. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Query performance
pages.description: Slow and expensive query diagnostics without displaying raw SQL text.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(avg_elapsed_time_ms), latest(execution_count) FROM PostgresSlowQueries WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET query_id, statement_type LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(execution_count) FROM PostgresSlowQueries WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET query_id LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(avg_disk_reads), latest(avg_disk_writes) FROM PostgresSlowQueries WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET query_id, statement_type LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Individual query CPU and execution time

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(cpu_time_ms), latest(exec_time_ms) FROM PostgresIndividualQueries WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET query_id, plan_id LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(plan_rows), latest(total_cost), latest(startup_cost) FROM PostgresExecutionPlanMetrics WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET node_type, query_id LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM PostgresSlowQueries WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' FACET database_name, schema_name, statement_type LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(databaseDuration), percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use query id, statement type, database, schema, and plan operation for triage. Do not display raw SQL text in shared dashboards.
